description: This file contains low-level implementation for SPI communication and dataflash memory management on an Atmel AT91 microcontroller. It includes functions for initializing SPI, sending commands, reading and writing to dataflash memory, and managing flash memory pages.

methods.name: void AT91F_SpiInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes the SPI interface and configures the relevant pins on the AT91 microcontroller.

methods.name: void AT91F_SpiEnable(int cs)
methods.description: Enables the SPI chip select for a specific dataflash device based on the provided chip select index.

methods.name: unsigned int AT91F_SpiWrite(AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDesc)
methods.description: Performs a SPI data transfer using the provided dataflash description structure.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashSendCommand(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char OpCode,unsigned int CmdSize,unsigned int DataflashAddress)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a command to the dataflash device, including setting the address and other parameters.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashGetStatus(AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDesc)
methods.description: Reads the status register from the dataflash device.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWaitReady(AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDataFlashDesc,unsigned int timeout)
methods.description: Polls the dataflash status register until the device indicates it is ready or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashContinuousRead(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,int src,unsigned char * dataBuffer,int sizeToRead)
methods.description: Performs a continuous stream read from the dataflash memory starting at a specified address.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_MainMemoryToBufferTransfer(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned int page)
methods.description: Transfers a page from main memory to a buffer within the dataflash device.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWriteBuffer(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned char * dataBuffer,unsigned int bufferAddress,int SizeToWrite)
methods.description: Writes data into the internal SRAM buffer of the dataflash device.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_PageErase(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned int page)
methods.description: Erases a specific page in dataflash memory.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_WriteBufferToMain(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char BufferCommand,unsigned int dest)
methods.description: Transfers data from internal buffer to main memory at the specified address.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_PartialPageWrite(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char * src,unsigned int dest,unsigned int size)
methods.description: Modifies part of a page by reading, updating, erasing, and rewriting the page.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashWrite(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned char * src,int dest,int size)
methods.description: High-level function to write arbitrary data buffers to the dataflash memory, handling partial page writes and page programming.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataFlashRead(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash,unsigned long addr,unsigned long size,char * buffer)
methods.description: Reads data from dataflash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: int AT91F_DataflashProbe(int cs,AT91PS_DataflashDesc pDesc)
methods.description: Initializes probe for a dataflash device to verify its presence and status.

methods.name: AT91S_DataFlashStatus AT91F_DataFlashErase(AT91PS_DataFlash pDataFlash)
methods.description: Erases all pages in the dataflash device.
